title: Enhancing Multilingual RAG Systems with Debiased Language Preference-Guided Query Fusion

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring intrinsic language preference in multilingual retrieval by calibrating raw preference scores (MLRS) against structural priors like exposure bias and gold availability using ridge regression to produce a debiased metric (DeLP).
Quantifying topic locality by predicting a query's primary locale language with an LLM and using it as a structural prior to isolate intrinsic language preference from locale-tied retrieval anchors.
